mutant.description: Difference control on the fetch step: the same local-only branch in a temporary repository with no origin ref, run once with the default fetch and once with --no-fetch.
mutant.expected: the default run refuses fetch-failed; the --no-fetch run passes step 1 and reaches the approval reader
mutant.observed: default run: MERGE-FORWARD branch=localonly result=REFUSED reason=fetch-failed (git: couldn't find remote ref refs/heads/localonly). --no-fetch run: REFUSED reason=status-unreadable, which is the reader stand-in printing nothing, so step 1 passed.
